fields.label: Radius
fields.help: Radius of the ascii lens around the cursor, relative to the screen height.

fields.label: Softness
fields.help: Edge feather of the lens as a fraction of the radius (0 to 1).

fields.label: Scale
fields.help: Size of one glyph pixel in CSS pixels. Characters are 5x5 glyph pixels.

fields.label: Spacing
fields.help: Empty glyph pixels around each character (0 to 3).

fields.label: Charset
fields.help: Built-in character ramp: real ascii glyphs, shade blocks, or binary digits.

fields.label: Glyphs
fields.help: Custom ramp of packed 5x5 bitmaps (dark to bright), overrides charset.

fields.label: Background
fields.help: Paper color behind the glyphs as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range, or "auto" to match the page background.

fields.label: Bg opacity
fields.help: Opacity of the background behind the glyphs (0 to 1).

fields.label: Contrast
fields.help: Contrast applied to character density before picking a glyph.

fields.label: Brightness
fields.help: Density offset applied before picking a glyph (-1 to 1).

fields.label: Invert
fields.help: Invert character density inside the effect (0 to 1).

fields.label: Strength
fields.help: Coverage of asciified cells inside the lens (0 to 1).

fields.label: Base strength
fields.help: Ascii coverage across the whole screen, outside the lens (0 to 1).

fields.label: Follow speed
fields.help: How quickly the lens follows the cursor. Higher is snappier.

fields.label: Text glow
fields.help: Soft phosphor glow around the text dots (0 to 1).

fields.label: Color fringe
fields.help: Soft chromatic aberration toward the lens edge (0 to 1).

fields.label: Src
fields.help: URL of the asset to display: GLB/glTF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF. Object URLs from a file input work too. The format is sniffed from the bytes, not the extension.

fields.label: ASCII
fields.help: Render the object as ASCII characters. Turn off to see the raw render.

fields.label: Cell size
fields.help: Height of one character cell in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Cell aspect
fields.help: Width of a character cell relative to its height (0.35 to 1.25).

fields.label: Charset
fields.help: Characters the renderer may choose from. Shapes are matched, not just brightness, and a space is always available for empty cells.

fields.label: Scene colors
fields.help: Tint each character with the scene color underneath it. Turn off for a single-color look.

fields.label: Character color
fields.help: Character color used when colored is off.

fields.label: Contrast
fields.help: Tone contrast of the character selection. 1 keeps the original tones, higher values deepen shadows.

fields.label: Edge snap
fields.help: How strongly characters snap to edges and contours of the object. 1 turns the effect off.

fields.label: Exposure
fields.help: Brightness multiplier applied before characters are chosen.

fields.label: Invert
fields.help: Invert the object tones so dark areas get the dense characters.

fields.label: Background
fields.help: Background color behind the characters. Empty string keeps the canvas transparent.

fields.label: Highlight
fields.help: Accent color of the ring light in the studio environment.

fields.label: Environment
fields.help: Brightness of the studio environment lighting.

fields.label: Roughness
fields.help: Roughness override applied to every material (0 to 1). Negative keeps the asset's own values.

fields.label: Scale
fields.help: Size of the longest side of the object in scene units. The camera sits about 4 units away.

fields.label: X offset
fields.help: Horizontal offset of the object in scene units.

fields.label: Y offset
fields.help: Vertical offset of the object in scene units.

fields.label: Float
fields.help: Strength of the floating bob animation (0 disables).

fields.label: Rocking
fields.help: Strength of the idle rocking rotation (0 disables).

fields.label: Float speed
fields.help: Speed of the float and rocking animation.

fields.label: Orbit
fields.help: Let the user orbit the camera by dragging.

fields.label: Scroll zoom
fields.help: Let the user zoom with the scroll wheel or pinch.

fields.label: Auto rotate
fields.help: Spin the camera around the object turntable-style.

fields.label: Auto Rotate Speed
fields.help: Turntable speed when autoRotate is on.

fields.label: Field of view
fields.help: Camera field of view in degrees.

fields.label: Camera distance
fields.help: Camera distance from the center of the object.

fields.label: Angle
fields.help: Sweep direction in degrees. 0 sweeps left to right, 90 sweeps bottom to top.

fields.label: Duration
fields.help: Seconds the sweep takes from one panel to the other.

fields.label: Band width
fields.help: Width of the ascii band as a fraction of the travel (0 to 1).

fields.label: Softness
fields.help: Feather of the band edges as a fraction of the band (0 to 1).

fields.label: Turbulence
fields.help: How ragged the sweep edge is. Higher tears the boundary apart row by row.

fields.label: Trail
fields.help: Length of the glowing trail left behind the band, as a fraction of the band.

fields.label: Progress
fields.help: Drives the sweep manually from 0 to 1. Set to -1 to let the component animate itself.

fields.label: Scale
fields.help: Size of one glyph pixel in CSS pixels. Characters are 5x5 glyph pixels.

fields.label: Spacing
fields.help: Empty glyph pixels around each character (0 to 3).

fields.label: Charset
fields.help: Built-in character ramp: real ascii glyphs, shade blocks, or binary digits.

fields.label: Glyphs
fields.help: Custom ramp of packed 5x5 bitmaps (dark to bright), overrides charset.

fields.label: Ink color
fields.help: Color of the sweeping characters, as any CSS color.

fields.label: Tint
fields.help: How strongly the ink color replaces the content color (0 to 1).

fields.label: Glow
fields.help: Soft phosphor glow around the characters (0 to 1).

fields.label: Color fringe
fields.help: Chromatic aberration across the band, in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Flicker
fields.help: How much characters flicker on and off as the band passes (0 to 1).

fields.label: Density
fields.help: Share of cells inside the band that light up (0 to 1).

fields.label: Row tear
fields.help: Horizontal tearing of content rows inside the band, in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Contrast
fields.help: Contrast applied to character density before picking a glyph.

fields.label: Brightness
fields.help: Density offset applied before picking a glyph (-1 to 1).

fields.label: Invert
fields.help: Invert character density inside the band (0 to 1).

fields.label: Threshold
fields.help: Contrast against the background above which a pixel counts as content and grows characters.

fields.label: Fade
fields.help: How far the content dims underneath the band (0 to 1).

fields.label: Blend
fields.help: How characters composite over the content. "auto" adds on dark pages and paints over on light ones.

fields.label: Background
fields.help: Color of the page behind the content, as any CSS color, or "auto" to read it from the DOM.

fields.label: Zone
fields.help: Height of the folded region at each edge in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Angle
fields.help: Maximum fold angle in degrees, reached away from the scroll ends. 90 is a cube edge.

fields.label: Rounding
fields.help: Radius in CSS pixels of the circular arc that rounds each fold crease. 0 keeps a sharp cube edge. Clamped to the zone height.

fields.label: Perspective
fields.help: Perspective focal length in CSS pixels. Smaller values pinch the folded edges harder.

fields.label: Bend direction
fields.help: "out" folds the edges away from the viewer like the outside of a cube, "in" tilts them toward the viewer.

fields.label: Ease
fields.help: Scroll distance in CSS pixels over which an edge flattens near its scroll end.

fields.label: Smoothing
fields.help: Seconds the bend takes to settle after a scroll. 0 snaps instantly.

fields.label: Top
fields.help: Bend the top edge.

fields.label: Bottom
fields.help: Bend the bottom edge.

fields.label: Tumble
fields.help: Overscroll tip strength (0 to 1). Rubber-banding past a scroll end tips the whole face over that edge. 0 disables.

fields.label: Tilt
fields.help: Pointer tilt strength (0 to 1). The face leans subtly toward the cursor. 0 disables.

fields.label: Interaction Rotation
fields.help: CSS rotation applied to the Bend host, used to keep pointer mapping aligned.

fields.label: Height
fields.help: Height of the blaze zone as a fraction of the screen (0 to 1).

fields.label: Distortion
fields.help: Strength of the heat distortion bending the content.

fields.label: Heat scale
fields.help: Scale of the heat distortion noise. Higher means finer ripples.

fields.label: Speed
fields.help: Animation speed multiplier for the whole effect.

fields.label: Sparks
fields.help: Brightness of the rising sparks. 0 disables them.

fields.label: Spark density
fields.help: How tightly packed the sparks are. Higher also makes them smaller.

fields.label: Spark size
fields.help: Size of the individual sparks.

fields.label: Layers
fields.help: Number of spark layers stacked for depth (1 to 10).

fields.label: Smoke
fields.help: Intensity of the smoke. 0 disables it.

fields.label: Glow
fields.help: Warm ambient glow near the bottom edge.

fields.label: Spark Color
fields.help: Spark color as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Smoke
fields.help: Smoke and glow color as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Thread size
fields.help: Height of one woven thread in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Thread width
fields.help: Width of the dark seams between threads (0 to 1).

fields.label: Texture
fields.help: How strongly the woven texture shades the paint (0 to 1).

fields.label: Tint
fields.help: Canvas paper color as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Tint strength
fields.help: How much the paper color warms the painting (0 to 1).

fields.label: Grain
fields.help: Amount of photographic grain worked into the paint (0 to 1).

fields.label: Halftone
fields.help: Amount of dotted halftone screen applied to the painting (0 to 1).

fields.label: Dot size
fields.help: Size of the halftone screen dots in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Strength
fields.help: Overall mix between the raw page (0) and the painting (1).

fields.label: Relief
fields.help: How far wet paint stands off the weave, lit in 3D (0 to 1).

fields.label: Gloss
fields.help: Sheen on fresh paint. Wet strokes catch the light, dry ones go matte (0 to 1).

fields.label: Bristle
fields.help: Definition of the bristle grooves combed through each stroke (0 to 1).

fields.label: Dry
fields.help: Seconds a stroke takes to level back into the canvas.

fields.label: Brush radius
fields.help: Radius of the brush, relative to the screen height.

fields.label: Intro
fields.help: Duration of the intro fade-in of the painting effect in seconds. 0 skips it.

fields.label: Follow speed
fields.help: How quickly the brush follows the cursor. Higher is snappier.

fields.label: Pinned edge
fields.help: Edge the cloth hangs from. The opposite side swings free.

fields.label: Wind
fields.help: Wind force driving the fabric (0 lets the waves die down).

fields.label: Speed
fields.help: Playback speed of the cloth motion.

fields.label: Fold height
fields.help: Height of the fabric folds in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Billow
fields.help: How many CSS pixels the cloth billows toward the viewer on a gust.

fields.label: Brush
fields.help: Strength of the waves the cursor brushes across the fabric (0 disables).

fields.label: Brush size
fields.help: Radius of the cursor's influence in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Settle
fields.help: How quickly waves settle (higher calms the fabric faster).

fields.label: Lighting
fields.help: Strength of the directional lighting on the folds (0 to 1).

fields.label: Sheen
fields.help: Strength of the soft sheen on fold crests (0 to 1).

fields.label: Shadow
fields.help: Opacity of the contact shadow under the fabric (0 to 1).

fields.label: Corners
fields.help: Corner radius of the fabric in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Backing
fields.help: Fabric color behind transparent content as RGB in the 0 to 1 range, or "auto" to sample the page background.

fields.label: Perspective
fields.help: Perspective focal length in CSS pixels. Lower exaggerates the 3D depth.

fields.label: Radius
fields.help: Decrypt radius around the cursor in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Softness
fields.help: Feather of the decrypt edge as a fraction of the radius (0 to 1).

fields.label: Cell size
fields.help: Glyph cell height in CSS pixels (4 to 40).

fields.label: Cell aspect
fields.help: Width of a glyph cell relative to its height (0.35 to 1.25).

fields.label: Charset
fields.help: Characters the cipher is written in. Order does not matter, shapes are matched automatically.

fields.label: Colored
fields.help: How much glyphs keep the color of the UI beneath them, 0 is monochrome (0 to 1).

fields.label: Cipher color
fields.help: Cipher color as any CSS color. Used for monochrome glyphs and the decrypt edge tint.

fields.label: Brightness
fields.help: Brightness of the cipher glyphs (0.2 to 3).

fields.label: Legibility
fields.help: Minimum contrast the cipher keeps against the background, so subtle UI stays readable while encrypted (0 to 1).

fields.label: Contrast
fields.help: Contrast of the glyph shape matching. Higher picks bolder characters (0.3 to 3).

fields.label: Exposure
fields.help: Exposure applied to the UI before it is matched to glyphs (0.2 to 3).

fields.label: Scramble
fields.help: Fraction of idle cipher cells that keep mutating (0 to 1).

fields.label: Scramble speed
fields.help: Cipher mutations per second (0 to 30).

fields.label: Edge width
fields.help: Width of the decrypting flicker band as a fraction of the radius (0 to 1).

fields.label: Edge flicker
fields.help: How violently characters flicker while they decrypt (0 to 1).

fields.label: Edge glow
fields.help: Brightness surge of glyphs on the decrypt wavefront (0 to 3).

fields.label: Edge tint
fields.help: How strongly the wavefront tints toward the cipher color (0 to 1).

fields.label: Aberration
fields.help: Chromatic aberration of the revealed UI at the decrypt edge in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Passthrough
fields.help: How much of the real UI shows through the cipher (0 to 1). 0 keeps the page fully encrypted.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.help: Contrast against the background above which a cell counts as UI and earns a glyph.

fields.label: Background
fields.help: Color of the backdrop behind the content, as any CSS color. Used to tell UI pixels apart from empty space.

fields.label: Smoothing
fields.help: Seconds the decrypt circle takes to catch up with the cursor. Higher feels more damped.

fields.label: Grid cells
fields.help: Cells across the width of the wrapped area (4 to 100).

fields.label: Cell aspect
fields.help: Width to height ratio of each cell (0.25 to 4). 1 is a perfect square.

fields.label: Radius
fields.help: Radius of the cursor influence as a fraction of the grid (0.02 to 1).

fields.label: Strength
fields.help: How hard cursor movement pushes cells around (0 to 1).

fields.label: Speed threshold
fields.help: Minimum cursor speed in CSS pixels per second before cells react. 0 reacts to any movement.

fields.label: Relaxation
fields.help: How slowly cells return to rest, per frame (0.5 to 0.99).

fields.label: Shift
fields.help: Multiplier on how far displaced cells shift the content (0 to 4).

fields.label: Color fringe
fields.help: Chromatic aberration inside each displaced cell (0 to 3).

fields.label: Grain
fields.help: Film grain over displaced cells (0 to 1).

fields.label: Grain size
fields.help: Grain speck size multiplier (0.5 to 4).

fields.label: Grain speed
fields.help: Grain animation speed (0 to 4).

fields.label: Scramble
fields.help: Random cell scramble on load that relaxes into place (0 to 3).

fields.label: Src
fields.help: URL of the asset to display: GLB/glTF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF. Object URLs from a file input work too. The format is sniffed from the bytes, not the extension.

fields.label: Pattern
fields.help: Dither pattern: an ordered Bayer grid, clustered halftone dots, or Floyd-Steinberg error diffusion.

fields.label: Grid size
fields.help: Size of the dither cells in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Pixelation
fields.help: Extra pixelation applied on top of the grid size (1 to 10).

fields.label: Grayscale
fields.help: Collapse the scene to grayscale before dithering.

fields.label: Invert
fields.help: Invert the final colors.

fields.label: Dither
fields.help: Enable the dither pass. Turn off to see the raw render.

fields.label: Background
fields.help: Background color behind the object. Empty string keeps the canvas transparent.

fields.label: Highlight
fields.help: Accent color of the ring light in the studio environment.

fields.label: Environment
fields.help: Brightness of the studio environment lighting.

fields.label: Roughness
fields.help: Roughness override applied to every material (0 to 1). Negative keeps the asset's own values.

fields.label: Scale
fields.help: Size of the longest side of the object in scene units. The camera sits about 4 units away.

fields.label: X offset
fields.help: Horizontal offset of the object in scene units.

fields.label: Y offset
fields.help: Vertical offset of the object in scene units.

fields.label: Float
fields.help: Strength of the floating bob animation (0 disables).

fields.label: Rocking
fields.help: Strength of the idle rocking rotation (0 disables).

fields.label: Float speed
fields.help: Speed of the float and rocking animation.

fields.label: Orbit
fields.help: Let the user orbit the camera by dragging.

fields.label: Scroll zoom
fields.help: Let the user zoom with the scroll wheel or pinch.

fields.label: Auto rotate
fields.help: Spin the camera around the object turntable-style.

fields.label: Auto Rotate Speed
fields.help: Turntable speed when autoRotate is on.

fields.label: Field of view
fields.help: Camera field of view in degrees.

fields.label: Camera distance
fields.help: Camera distance from the center of the object.

fields.label: Intensity
fields.help: How much rain falls, from a light drizzle to a downpour (0 to 1.25).

fields.label: Speed
fields.help: Animation speed multiplier.

fields.label: Scale
fields.help: Size of the droplet pattern. Higher means smaller drops.

fields.label: Drop width
fields.help: Width of the droplets and their trails.

fields.label: Drop length
fields.help: How elongated the falling droplets are.

fields.label: Refraction
fields.help: How strongly droplets refract the content behind them.

fields.label: Blur
fields.help: Background blur outside the droplets, like a fogged up window.

fields.label: Vignette
fields.help: Darkens the edges of the canvas (0 to 1).

fields.label: Fall speed
fields.help: How fast the running drops slide down.

fields.label: Wiggle
fields.help: Horizontal wiggle of the running drops.

fields.label: Static drops
fields.help: Multiplier for the small static droplets.

fields.label: Interactive
fields.help: Wipe drops off the glass with the pointer.

fields.label: Wipe radius
fields.help: Radius of the cursor wipe, relative to the screen height.

fields.label: Wipe strength
fields.help: How strongly the cursor wipes drops off the glass (0 to 1).

fields.label: Wipe distort
fields.help: How much the wipe distorts the content behind it.

fields.label: Tint
fields.help: Tint color layered over the content as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Tint strength
fields.help: Strength of the tint (0 to 1).

fields.label: Color
fields.help: Flame color as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Intensity
fields.help: Overall brightness of the fire (0 to 3).

fields.label: Flame height
fields.help: Reach of the flames above the top edge in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Glow spread
fields.help: Reach of the glow on the sides and bottom in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Corner radius
fields.help: Corner radius of the burning outline in CSS pixels. Match your content.

fields.label: Speed
fields.help: Animation speed multiplier for the whole effect.

fields.label: Detail
fields.help: Flame detail from 0 (broad licks) to 1 (fine licks).

fields.label: Turbulence
fields.help: Amplitude of the turbulence waves shaping the flames (0 to 1).

fields.label: Turbulence scale
fields.help: Frequency multiplier of the turbulence waves (0.2 to 3).

fields.label: Turbulence reach
fields.help: How far from the edges the heat warps the content, in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Sparks
fields.help: Brightness of the spark highlights (0 to 3). 0 disables them.

fields.label: Spark size
fields.help: Size multiplier for individual sparks (0.2 to 3).

fields.label: Spark density
fields.help: How many sparks fly at once (0.3 to 2.5).

fields.label: Spark speed
fields.help: How fast sparks rise and flicker (0.1 to 3).

fields.label: Molten rim
fields.help: Strength of the molten glow hugging the edges (0 to 3).

fields.label: Edge melt
fields.help: How far the flames eat into the content silhouette in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Heat shimmer
fields.help: Heat shimmer displacement of the content near the edges in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Smoke
fields.help: Amount of smoke drifting off the flames (0 to 2).

fields.label: Ember glow
fields.help: Brightness of the glowing ember line on the burnt edges (0 to 2).

fields.label: Scorch
fields.help: Darkness of the charred band on the content edges (0 to 2).

fields.label: Shape
fields.help: Cell shape of the energy lattice.

fields.label: Field color
fields.help: Field color as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Edge color
fields.help: Color of the dissolve edge glow as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Opacity
fields.help: Overall field opacity (0 to 1).

fields.label: Cell scale
fields.help: Cells across the shorter screen axis (4 to 80).

fields.label: Line width
fields.help: Thickness of the lattice lines (0.005 to 0.2).

fields.label: Grid opacity
fields.help: Brightness of the lattice grid (0 to 1).

fields.label: Grid reveal
fields.help: How the lattice is revealed: always visible, near the cursor, by click ripples, or both.

fields.label: Reveal strength
fields.help: Brightness of the revealed lattice in hover/click/both modes (0 to 3).

fields.label: Reveal radius
fields.help: Radius of the hover reveal in CSS pixels (60 to 800).

fields.label: Reveal fade
fields.help: Fade smoothness of the reveal edge (0.02 to 1).

fields.label: Flash Speed
fields.help: Random per-cell flash speed (0 to 4).

fields.label: Cell flash
fields.help: Random per-cell flash brightness (0 to 1).

fields.label: Flow Scale
fields.help: Scale of the drifting energy noise (0.5 to 12).

fields.label: Flow speed
fields.help: Drift speed of the energy noise (0 to 4).

fields.label: Energy flow
fields.help: Brightness of the energy noise (0 to 4).

fields.label: Edge glow
fields.help: Glow creeping in from the screen edges, the fresnel analog (0 to 4).

fields.label: Edge Falloff
fields.help: How far the edge glow reaches into the screen (0.02 to 0.6).

fields.label: Reveal
fields.help: Reveal progress. 1 is fully materialized, 0 is gone (noise dissolve).

fields.label: Dissolve Scale
fields.help: Scale of the dissolve noise (0.5 to 12).

fields.label: Dissolve Width
fields.help: Width of the burning dissolve edge (0.005 to 0.2).

fields.label: Dissolve Glow
fields.help: Brightness of the dissolve edge (0 to 12).

fields.label: Ripple speed
fields.help: Expansion speed of click ripples in screens per second (0.1 to 4).

fields.label: Ripple Width
fields.help: Ring thickness of click ripples (0.01 to 0.4).

fields.label: Ripple blend
fields.help: How softly ripple rings feather into the page, 0 is tight, 1 is airy (0 to 1).

fields.label: Ripple Duration
fields.help: Lifetime of one ripple in seconds (0.3 to 5).

fields.label: Ripple power
fields.help: Brightness of ripples and impact flashes (0 to 8).

fields.label: Ripple Max Radius
fields.help: Max radius a ripple can reach, in screens (0.1 to 2).

fields.label: Impact Radius
fields.help: Radius of the cell flash burst around an impact (0 to 0.5).

fields.label: Refraction
fields.help: How much ripples push the page outward and warp the lattice (0 to 60).

fields.label: Color fringe
fields.help: Chromatic aberration inside refracted rings (0 to 8).

fields.label: Heat haze
fields.help: Living heat-haze shimmer that warps the page beneath the field (0 to 2).

fields.label: Page react
fields.help: Lattice reacts to the page: cells over bright content glow brighter (0 to 1).

fields.label: Page tint
fields.help: Tints the page toward the field color, like looking through the shield (0 to 1).

fields.label: Hover glow
fields.help: Glow following the cursor (0 to 3).

fields.label: Hover radius
fields.help: Radius of the cursor glow in CSS pixels (40 to 600).

fields.label: Hover charge
fields.help: Cells light up when the cursor crosses them (0 to 2).

fields.label: Hide on hover
fields.help: Fade the field out around the cursor instead of intensifying it.

fields.label: Page dim
fields.help: How much the page dims beneath the field (0 to 1).

fields.label: Bloom
fields.help: Bloom amount applied to bright field energy (0 to 3).

fields.label: Bloom Threshold
fields.help: Bloom brightness cutoff (0 to 1).

fields.label: Grain
fields.help: Animated film grain over the field (0 to 1).

fields.label: Click Ripples
fields.help: Spawn ripples on click (default true).

fields.label: Frost
fields.help: Base frozen coverage added on top of the frost pattern (0-1).

fields.label: Strength
fields.help: Multiplier on the frost noise pattern. Higher freezes more of the pane.

fields.label: Contrast
fields.help: Contrast of the frost noise pattern.

fields.label: Crispness
fields.help: Contrast of the final frost mask. Higher gives crisper frost edges.

fields.label: Highlight
fields.help: How much sparkling highlight grain mixes into the frost (0-1).

fields.label: Highlight Strength
fields.help: How strongly highlights tint toward white (0-1).

fields.label: Haze
fields.help: Base blur haze mixed over the content, even outside thick frost (0-1).

fields.label: Tint thin
fields.help: Frost color where the layer is thin, as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Tint thick
fields.help: Frost color where the layer is thick, as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Tint
fields.help: How much the frost tint colors the frozen areas (0-1).

fields.label: Saturation
fields.help: Saturation multiplier applied to the frosted content.

fields.label: Brightness
fields.help: Brightness multiplier applied to the frosted content.

fields.label: Refraction
fields.help: How far the icy surface bends light. 0 disables refraction.

fields.label: Ior
fields.help: Index of refraction of the ice. Water ice is about 1.31.

fields.label: Detail
fields.help: Strength of the fine surface detail in the refraction.

fields.label: Texture scale
fields.help: Scale of the icy relief pattern. Higher is larger features.

fields.label: Fresnel
fields.help: Fresnel boost at grazing angles (0-2).

fields.label: Melt radius
fields.help: Radius of the melt spot under the cursor (0-1, fraction of height).

fields.label: Melt noise
fields.help: Irregularity of the melt edge. 0 is a clean circle.

fields.label: Melt speed
fields.help: How quickly hovering melts the frost (0-1).

fields.label: Refreeze
fields.help: How fast melted areas freeze back over. 0 never refreezes.

fields.label: Edge Fade
fields.help: Keeps the edges of the pane frozen. 0 lets everything melt.

fields.label: Melt edges
fields.help: Lets the frozen borders of the pane melt too.

fields.label: Intro Duration
fields.help: Seconds for the frost to grow in from the edges on load. 0 disables.

fields.label: Opacity
fields.help: Overall opacity of the frost layer (0-1). Lower shows more content.

fields.label: Shimmer
fields.help: Animated twinkle of the highlight grain (0-1). 0 is static.

fields.label: Quality
fields.help: Resolution multiplier for the blur passes (0.25-1).

fields.label: Lens shape
fields.help: Lens shape.

fields.label: Size
fields.help: Lens size (radius, or half height for rectangles) in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Aspect
fields.help: Width to height ratio of the rectangle shape (1 to 3).

fields.label: Corner
fields.help: Corner radius for square and rectangle shapes in CSS pixels.

fields.label: IOR
fields.help: Index of refraction of the glass (1 to 2). Higher bends light more.

fields.label: Edge
fields.help: Fraction of the lens that stays optically flat before the rim (0 to 1).

fields.label: Bevel
fields.help: How sharply the rim curves away (1 to 10).

fields.label: Depth
fields.help: Optical depth in CSS pixels: how far the glass floats above the page.

fields.label: Aberration
fields.help: Chromatic aberration strength at the rim (0 to 3). 0 disables it.

fields.label: Blur
fields.help: Frosted blur of the glass face (0 = optically clear, up to 4).

fields.label: Reflection
fields.help: Strength of the fresnel reflection on the rim (0 to 2). 0 disables it.

fields.label: Shine
fields.help:
Specular rim highlight (0 to 2). Keeps the lens visible even over plain
backgrounds where clear glass would otherwise be invisible. 0 disables it.

fields.label: Zoom
fields.help: Magnification while hovering a target element (1 to 3).

fields.label: Targets
fields.help: CSS selector for elements that trigger the crystal ball zoom.

fields.label: Follow
fields.help: How quickly the lens follows the cursor (0 to 1). 1 snaps to it.

fields.label: Src
fields.help: URL of the asset to display: GLB/glTF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF. Object URLs from a file input work too. The format is sniffed from the bytes, not the extension.

fields.label: Refraction
fields.help: Index of refraction of the glass (1 to 2.33).

fields.label: Thickness
fields.help: Thickness of the glass volume in scene units. Drives how strongly light bends.

fields.label: Frost
fields.help: Surface roughness (0 to 1). Higher values frost the glass.

fields.label: Dispersion
fields.help: Chromatic dispersion of the refraction (0 to 2). Splits light into rainbow fringes like real glass.

fields.label: Clearcoat
fields.help: Clearcoat layer on top of the glass (0 to 1).

fields.label: Tint
fields.help: Tint color of the glass volume as any CSS color. Empty string keeps the glass clear.

fields.label: Tint density
fields.help: How strongly the tint absorbs light through the volume.

fields.label: Depth
fields.help: Extrusion depth of 2D assets (SVG or image) as a fraction of their longest side.

fields.label: Bevel
fields.help: Edge rounding of extruded 2D assets (0 to 1). Higher values melt the edges into a liquid lip.

fields.label: Highlight
fields.help: Accent color of the ring light in the studio environment.

fields.label: Lighting
fields.help: Brightness of the studio environment lighting.

fields.label: Background
fields.help: Background color behind the glass. Empty string keeps the canvas transparent.

fields.label: Background Image
fields.help: URL of an image shown as a backdrop behind the glass, cover-fit to the view. The glass samples and refracts it. Empty string disables the backdrop.

fields.label: Scale
fields.help: Size of the longest side of the asset in scene units. The camera sits about 4 units away.

fields.label: X offset
fields.help: Horizontal offset of the asset in scene units.

fields.label: Y offset
fields.help: Vertical offset of the asset in scene units.

fields.label: Float
fields.help: Strength of the floating bob animation (0 disables).

fields.label: Rocking
fields.help: Strength of the idle rocking rotation (0 disables).

fields.label: Float speed
fields.help: Speed of the float and rocking animation.

fields.label: Orbit
fields.help: Let the user orbit the camera by dragging.

fields.label: Scroll zoom
fields.help: Let the user zoom with the scroll wheel or pinch.

fields.label: Auto rotate
fields.help: Spin the camera around the asset turntable-style.

fields.label: Auto Rotate Speed
fields.help: Turntable speed when autoRotate is on.

fields.label: Field of view
fields.help: Camera field of view in degrees.

fields.label: Camera distance
fields.help: Camera distance from the center of the asset.

fields.label: Intensity
fields.help: Overall strength of the glitch (0 to 2).

fields.label: Interval
fields.help: Seconds between glitch bursts. 0 keeps the glitch running constantly.

fields.label: Duration
fields.help: How long each burst lasts in seconds.

fields.label: Slices
fields.help: Number of horizontal slices the tear snaps to. Lower is chunkier.

fields.label: Shift
fields.help: How far the torn slices shift sideways, in CSS pixels.

fields.label: RGB Shift
fields.help: Chromatic RGB split during bursts, in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Blocks
fields.help: Amount of corrupted block artifacts during bursts (0 to 1).

fields.label: Noise
fields.help: Analog noise and scanline flicker during bursts (0 to 1).

fields.label: Charset
fields.help: Characters used for the falling glyphs. Deduplicated into a glyph atlas.

fields.label: Glyph size
fields.help: Size of one glyph cell in CSS pixels (8 to 64).

fields.label: Rain color
fields.help: Rain color as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Head color
fields.help: Color of the bright head glyph as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Speed
fields.help: Fall speed in screen heights per second (0.05 to 3).

fields.label: Speed variance
fields.help: Per-column speed variation (0 to 1).

fields.label: Density
fields.help: Fraction of drops that spawn each cycle (0 to 1).

fields.label: Trail
fields.help: Length multiplier for the fading trails (0.2 to 3).

fields.label: Glow
fields.help: Brightness of the drop heads and the light they cast (0 to 3).

fields.label: Mutation
fields.help: How fast glyphs mutate into other characters (0 to 4).

fields.label: Flicker
fields.help: Random brightness flicker of the streaks (0 to 1).

fields.label: Layers
fields.help: Parallax rain layers behind the front one (1 to 3).

fields.label: Page dim
fields.help: How much the unlit page dims (0 to 1). 0 keeps it fully readable.

fields.label: Light
fields.help: Strength of the light the drops shine onto the page (0 to 3).

fields.label: Light radius
fields.help: Radius of each drop's light pool in CSS pixels (20 to 600).

fields.label: Light height
fields.help: How high above the page the lights float, in CSS pixels. Higher is softer.

fields.label: Relief
fields.help: Embossed 3D shading of the page under the lights (0 to 2).

fields.label: Stir
fields.help: How strongly the cursor stirs the rain as it passes (0 to 1). 0 disables it.

fields.label: Stir radius
fields.help: How far the stirring reaches to either side of the cursor, in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Settle
fields.help: Seconds the stirred wake takes to settle back to its own rhythm.

fields.label: Tile size
fields.help: Size of each grid tile in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Gap
fields.help: Gap between tiles in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Corner radius
fields.help: Corner radius of each tile in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Amplitude
fields.help: Overall strength of the wave displacement.

fields.label: Wave speed
fields.help: How fast the wavefront expands, in screen heights per second.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: Spatial oscillation of the wave. Higher means more ripples per wave.

fields.label: Wave width
fields.help: Width of the wave ring as a fraction of the screen height.

fields.label: Fade time
fields.help: Seconds for a wave to fade to roughly a third of its strength.

fields.label: Max lift
fields.help: Maximum lift a tile can reach (0 to 1).

fields.label: Jitter
fields.help: Per-tile randomness in how tiles respond to the wave (0 to 1).

fields.label: Lift height
fields.help: How high a fully lifted cube rises, in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Perspective
fields.help: Camera distance in CSS pixels, like CSS perspective. Lower is more dramatic.

fields.label: Tilt
fields.help: How much the camera vanishing point leans toward the cursor (0 to 1).

fields.label: Shading
fields.help: Strength of the lighting on cube tops and side walls.

fields.label: Tint
fields.help: Color lifted tiles blend toward as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Tint strength
fields.help: How strongly lifted tiles take on the tint color (0 to 1).

fields.label: Idle ripples
fields.help: Seconds between ambient ripples when the cursor is idle. 0 disables.

fields.label: Size
fields.help: Width of each hex tile in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Gap
fields.help: Seam between tiles in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Bevel
fields.help: Width of the shiny beveled rim in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Tilt
fields.help: Backward lean of the page in degrees (-30 to 30). Positive tilts the top away.

fields.label: Perspective
fields.help: Camera closeness (0 to 1). Higher exaggerates the perspective of the tilt.

fields.label: Float
fields.help: How far tiles bob up and down as they float (0 to 1). 0 keeps them still.

fields.label: Speed
fields.help: Speed of the floating motion. 1 is normal speed.

fields.label: Shine
fields.help: Intensity of the specular glints on rims and tile faces (0 to 2).

fields.label: Lift
fields.help: How strongly tiles rise along the edges of the fluid reading window (0 to 1).

fields.label: Radius
fields.help: Size of the fluid splats the cursor injects, in CSS pixels. Sets the reading window's scale.

fields.label: Flow
fields.help: How strongly cursor movement pushes the fluid around (0 to 3).

fields.label: Swirl
fields.help: Vorticity of the fluid (0 to 15). Higher makes the window's trail curl into eddies.

fields.label: Trail
fields.help: How long the fluid trail lingers before healing (0 to 1).

fields.label: Iridescence
fields.help: Strength of the iridescent hue shift on highlights (0 to 2). 0 keeps highlights neutral.

fields.label: Bloom
fields.help: Bloom glow around bright highlights (0 to 1). 0 skips the pass entirely.

fields.label: Grain
fields.help: Animated film grain over the final image (0 to 1). 0 skips the pass entirely.

fields.label: Gap Color
fields.help: Seam color as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range, or "auto" to derive a dark seam from the page background.

fields.label: Src
fields.help: URL of the asset to display: GLB/glTF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF. Object URLs from a file input work too. The format is sniffed from the bytes, not the extension.

fields.label: Ink
fields.help: Enable the ink pass. Turn off to see the raw render.

fields.label: Ink color
fields.help: Color of the ink strokes.

fields.label: Line spacing
fields.help: Distance between stroke centers in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Stroke weight
fields.help: Thickness of the strokes relative to the line spacing (0 to 1.5).

fields.label: Angle
fields.help: Angle of the stroke lines in degrees.

fields.label: Dash length
fields.help: Length scale of the dash breakup along each stroke, in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Dash breakup
fields.help: How aggressively strokes break into dashes as the tone lightens (0 keeps solid lines).

fields.label: Bleed
fields.help: Ragged ink bleed along the stroke edges (0 to 1).

fields.label: Grain
fields.help: Dry-brush speckle eaten out of the ink (0 to 1).

fields.label: Wobble
fields.help: Hand-pressed waviness of the stroke lines (0 to 1).

fields.label: Relief
fields.help: How far the stroke lines ride the surface height read from the depth buffer, so they wrap a 3D form. Flat art is unaffected.

fields.label: Depth
fields.help: Extrusion depth of 2D assets (SVG or image) as a fraction of their longest side.

fields.label: Contrast
fields.help: Slope of the tone-to-ink ramp. Higher crushes midtones into solid black or bare paper.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.help: Tone that lands at half ink coverage. Raise it to ink only the darkest areas.

fields.label: Softness
fields.help: Softness of the stroke edges (0 is a hard letterpress edge).

fields.label: Invert
fields.help: Ink the light areas instead of the dark ones.

fields.label: Background
fields.help: Paper color behind the ink. Empty string keeps the canvas transparent.

fields.label: Highlight
fields.help: Accent color of the ring light in the studio environment.

fields.label: Environment
fields.help: Brightness of the studio environment lighting.

fields.label: Roughness
fields.help: Roughness override applied to every material (0 to 1). Negative keeps the asset's own values.

fields.label: Scale
fields.help: Size of the longest side of the object in scene units. The camera sits about 4 units away.

fields.label: X offset
fields.help: Horizontal offset of the object in scene units.

fields.label: Y offset
fields.help: Vertical offset of the object in scene units.

fields.help: Strength of the floating bob animation (0 disables).

fields.help: Strength of the idle rocking rotation (0 disables).

fields.help: Turntable speed when autoRotate is on.

fields.help: Animation speed of the beam wave, flicker, and sparkle. 1 is normal.

fields.label: Offset
fields.help: Distance of the beam from the bottom edge in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Color
fields.help: Laser glow color as RGB in the 0 to 1 range.

fields.label: Thickness
fields.help: Thickness of the white-hot beam core in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Core
fields.help: Intensity of the white beam core (0 to 2). 0 removes it.

fields.label: Radius
fields.help: Reach of the colored glow around the beam in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Glow
fields.help: Brightness of the colored glow (0 to 3). 0 removes it.

fields.label: Wave
fields.help: Amplitude of the slow beam waviness in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Width
fields.help: Beam length as a fraction of the content width (0 to 1).

fields.label: Flicker
fields.help: Random intensity flicker of the beam (0 to 1).

fields.label: Reveal
fields.help: Height of the hot reveal band above the beam in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Heat
fields.help: How strongly freshly revealed content glows (0 to 1.5).

fields.label: Shimmer
fields.help: Heat shimmer displacement of freshly revealed content in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Sparkle
fields.help: Animated sparkle texture inside the reveal band (0 to 2).

fields.label: Reactivity
fields.help: How much scrolling boosts the beam and the reveal glow (0 to 3).

fields.label: Sim Resolution
fields.help: Resolution of the simulation grid.

fields.label: Dye Resolution
fields.help: Resolution of the fluid trail texture.

fields.label: Trail fade
fields.help: How much the trail persists each frame (closer to 1 lasts longer).

fields.label: Motion fade
fields.help: How much motion persists each frame (closer to 1 lasts longer).

fields.label: Pressure
fields.help: How much pressure carries over between frames.

fields.label: Swirl
fields.help: Pressure solver iterations.

fields.label: Curl
fields.help: Rotational force added back into the flow.

fields.label: Radius
fields.help: Radius of the pointer splat.

fields.label: Force
fields.help: Force multiplier applied on pointer movement.

fields.label: Intensity
fields.help: Strength of the color tint left by the flow.

fields.label: Distortion
fields.help: How strongly the flow warps the content.

fields.label: Blend
fields.help: How much of the fluid color blends over the content.

fields.label: Color
fields.help: Trail color as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range. Ignored when rainbow is on.

fields.label: Rainbow
fields.help: Color the trail from the flow direction instead of a fixed color.

fields.label: Src
fields.help: URL of the asset to display: GLB/glTF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF. Object URLs from a file input work too. The format is sniffed from the bytes, not the extension.

fields.label: Distortion
fields.help: How far the liquid drags the object as it flows.

fields.label: Color fringe
fields.help: Strength of the chromatic lens fringe in a soft radius around the cursor.

fields.label: Grain
fields.help: Amount of animated film grain. Subtle across the frame, strongest inside the cursor lens.

fields.label: Shine
fields.help: Brightness of the light glinting off the moving liquid.

fields.label: Cursor size
fields.help: Size of the area the cursor disturbs.

fields.label: Cursor Force
fields.help: How hard the cursor pushes the liquid.

fields.label: Ripples
fields.help: How long the ripples keep flowing after the cursor stops.

fields.label: Swirl
fields.help: How much the flow curls into swirls and eddies.

fields.label: Iridescence
fields.help: Strength of the rainbow shimmer that appears where the liquid flows.

fields.label: Splash
fields.help: Strength of the liquid burst fired when the canvas is clicked or tapped (0 disables).

fields.label: Idle drift
fields.help: Amount of slow idle drift that keeps the surface alive while the cursor is away.

fields.label: Wobble
fields.help: How much the object tilts and bounces like jelly in response to the cursor.

fields.label: Gloss
fields.help: Surface finish of extruded 2D assets, from matte to mirror. Models keep their own materials.

fields.label: Metallic
fields.help: How metallic the asset reads. 0 keeps the original material finish, 1 turns it to polished metal.

fields.label: Tint

fields.label: Depth

fields.label: Bevel

fields.label: Scroll zoom
fields.help: Let the wheel or trackpad adjust the magnification while zoomModifier is held.

fields.label: Hold
fields.help: Key held to zoom instead of scroll. "none" captures every wheel event over the content.

fields.label: Accent
fields.help: HUD accent color as RGB in the 0 to 1 range. Tints the reticle, readout, and ripple outline.

fields.label: Follow
fields.help: How quickly the lens follows the cursor (0 to 1). 1 snaps to it.

fields.label: HUD
fields.help: Overall HUD intensity (0 to 1). 0 hides every reticle element.

fields.label: Ring
fields.help: Show the outer ring.

fields.label: Crosshair
fields.help: Show the crosshair lines through the center.

fields.label: Ticks
fields.help: Show the tick marks around the ring.

fields.label: Brackets
fields.help: Show the corner brackets inside the lens.

fields.label: Center dot
fields.help: Show the center dot.

fields.label: Grid
fields.help: Show a faint measurement grid inside the lens.

fields.label: Readout
fields.help: Show the data readout beside the lens.

fields.label: Aberration
fields.help: Chromatic aberration split inside the lens (0 to 3). 0 disables it.

fields.label: Haze
fields.help: Dreamy insight haze inside the lens (0 to 1). Softens and lifts the magnified content.

fields.label: Click ripples
fields.help: Emit a ripple across the page on click.

fields.label: Ripple speed
fields.help: How fast the ripple wavefront travels, in CSS pixels per second.

fields.label: Ripple width
fields.help: Thickness of the colored ripple outline in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Bend width
fields.help: Width of the band the ripple bends, in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Ripple bend
fields.help: How many CSS pixels the ripple bends the page.

fields.label: Ripple glow
fields.help: Strength of the colored ripple outline (0 to 2). 0 hides it.

fields.label: Ripple Life
fields.help: Seconds a ripple lives before it fades out.

fields.label: Src
fields.help: URL of the asset to display: GLB/glTF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF. Object URLs from a file input work too. The format is sniffed from the bytes, not the extension.

fields.label: Particles
fields.help: Number of particles the asset is rebuilt from.

fields.label: Size
fields.help: Particle size in CSS pixels at the model's distance.

fields.label: Variance
fields.help: Random per-particle size variation (0 to 1).

fields.label: Color
fields.help: Override color as any CSS color. Empty string keeps the asset's own colors.

fields.label: Push radius
fields.help: Radius of the cursor's push field in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Push strength
fields.help: How hard the cursor pushes particles away.

fields.label: Swirl
fields.help: Tangential curl of the push (0 to 2). Particles spiral around the cursor instead of only fleeing it.

fields.label: Spring
fields.help: How quickly displaced particles spring back home.

fields.label: Damping
fields.help: Velocity damping (0 to 1). Lower values keep particles wobbling longer.

fields.label: Drift
fields.help: Idle shimmer of the resting particles (0 disables).

fields.label: Camera distance
fields.help: Camera distance from the center of the asset.

fields.label: Radius
fields.help: Reveal radius around the cursor in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Softness
fields.help: Feather of the reveal edge as a fraction of the radius (0 to 1).

fields.label: Size
fields.help: Particle grain size in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Scatter
fields.help: How far grains wander from their home pixel in CSS pixels. Bright content spawns the farthest specks.

fields.label: Drift
fields.help: Speed of the idle grain shimmer (0 freezes the dust).

fields.label: Aberration
fields.help: Chromatic aberration strength at the reveal edge in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Bend
fields.help: How strongly unrevealed content smears around the reveal edge in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Fade
fields.help: How strongly dust specks stand out from the background (0 to 1).

fields.label: Threshold
fields.help: Contrast against the background above which a pixel counts as UI and dissolves into dust. Pixels close to the background color are left untouched.

fields.label: Background
fields.help: Color of the backdrop behind the content, as any CSS color. Used to tell UI pixels apart from empty space.

fields.label: Smoothing
fields.help: Seconds the reveal takes to catch up with the cursor. Higher feels more damped.

fields.label: Point
fields.help: Viewport fraction of the formation line. Content assembles as it scrolls up past this line and dissolves back below it.

fields.label: Band
fields.help: Height in CSS pixels of the transition band where particles progressively reassemble.

fields.label: Density
fields.help: Grain spacing in CSS pixels. Smaller values mean finer, denser sand.

fields.label: Size
fields.help: Size of fully scattered dust grains in CSS pixels. Grains grow to cover their cell as they land.

fields.label: Spread
fields.help: Maximum distance in CSS pixels particles scatter from their home position.

fields.label: Gravity
fields.help: Downward bias of the scattered cloud (-1 to 1), like sand settling. Negative values lift it.

fields.label: Drift
fields.help: Idle float speed of scattered particles (0 to 1). 0 freezes the cloud.

fields.label: Swirl
fields.help: Sideways arc in CSS pixels particles take while flying home.

fields.label: Stagger
fields.help: Per-particle randomness of reassembly timing (0 to 1).

fields.label: Fade
fields.help: Opacity of fully scattered particles (0 to 1).

fields.label: Settle
fields.help: Seconds a row of dust takes to condense into the page once the reveal reaches it.

fields.label: Smoothing
fields.help: Seconds the damped scroll takes to catch up with the real scroll. Higher feels more fluid.

fields.label: Peel side
fields.help: Edge the content peels from.

fields.label: Peel mode
fields.help: How the peel is driven. "cursor" peels progressively as the pointer nears the edge, "hover" peels fully when the pointer enters the zone.

fields.label: Reveal
fields.help: How many CSS pixels of the under layer are exposed at full peel.

fields.label: Zone
fields.help: Width of the strip along the chosen edge that drives the peel, in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Curl
fields.help: Radius of the curl in CSS pixels. Smaller values fold sharper.

fields.label: Bow
fields.help: Extra lift at the middle of the peeling edge in CSS pixels. Negative values bow the sheet inwards.

fields.label: Shade
fields.help: Strength of the curl shading on the lifted sheet (0 to 1).

fields.label: Shine
fields.help: Strength of the shine along the peeling edge that follows the cursor (0 to 1).

fields.label: Shine distance
fields.help: Distance from the edge at which the shine starts to appear, in CSS pixels. 0 uses the full container span.

fields.label: Shine color
fields.help: Shine color as RGB in the 0 to 1 range, or "auto" to follow the page theme: light shine on dark backgrounds, dark shine on light ones. Re-resolves on theme changes.

fields.label: Bulge
fields.help: How many CSS pixels the peeled edge bulges toward the cursor.

fields.label: Perspective
fields.help: Perspective focal length in CSS pixels. Lower values exaggerate the 3D depth.

fields.label: Smoothing
fields.help: Seconds the peel takes to settle. Higher feels more damped.

fields.label: Radius
fields.help: Radius of the dither lens around the cursor, relative to the screen height.

fields.label: Softness
fields.help: Edge feather of the lens as a fraction of the radius (0 to 1).

fields.label: Pixel size
fields.help: Size of the retro pixels in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Levels
fields.help: Number of brightness levels the dither quantizes to.

fields.label: Dark Color
fields.help: Dark end of the palette as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Light Color
fields.help: Light end of the palette as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Colorize
fields.help: Blend from the content's own colors (0) to the palette (1).

fields.label: Contrast
fields.help: Contrast applied to brightness before dithering.

fields.label: Brightness
fields.help: Brightness offset applied before dithering (-1 to 1).

fields.label: Strength
fields.help: Coverage of the dithered pixels inside the lens (0 to 1).

fields.label: Base strength
fields.help: Dither coverage across the whole screen, outside the lens (0 to 1).

fields.label: Invert
fields.help: Invert brightness inside the effect (0 to 1).

fields.label: Scanlines
fields.help: Intensity of the retro scanline overlay (0 to 1).

fields.label: Pattern
fields.help: Dither pattern used for intermediate levels.

fields.label: Trail
fields.help: Phosphor burn-in: the lens leaves a fading ghost along the cursor path (0 to 1).

fields.label: Degauss
fields.help: Strength of the degauss ripple triggered on click (0 to 1).

fields.label: Follow speed
fields.help: How quickly the lens follows the cursor. Higher is snappier.

fields.label: Amplitude
fields.help: Height of the waves (0 to 3).

fields.label: Speed
fields.help: How fast the rings travel outward. 1 is normal speed.

fields.label: Wavelength
fields.help: Distance between wave crests in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Rings
fields.help: Number of crests in each wave train (1 to 8).

fields.label: Decay
fields.help: How quickly the waves lose energy (higher dies faster).

fields.label: Refraction
fields.help: How strongly the waves bend the page content, in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Dispersion
fields.help: Chromatic dispersion splitting colors along the wave slopes (0 to 1).

fields.label: Shine
fields.help: Intensity of the light glints on the wave crests (0 to 2).

fields.label: Trigger
fields.help: What spawns ripples. "click" on press, "hover" also leaves a wake while moving, "none" only ambient.

fields.label: Interval
fields.help: Seconds between ambient ripples at random positions. 0 disables them.

fields.label: Radius
fields.help: Radius of the shatter lens around the cursor, relative to the screen height.

fields.label: Softness
fields.help: Edge feather of the lens as a fraction of the radius (0 to 1).

fields.label: Tile size
fields.help: Tile size in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Shards
fields.help: Shape irregularity. 0 keeps a perfect square grid, 1 breaks the page into uneven glass shards.

fields.label: Corner
fields.help: Corner rounding of fully lifted tiles in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Lift
fields.help: How high tiles lift off the page in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Tilt
fields.help: How steeply tiles tip out of the page plane (0 to 3).

fields.label: Scatter
fields.help: How far tiles slide sideways while lifted, in CSS pixels.

fields.label: Perspective
fields.help: Perspective distance in CSS pixels. Lower is more dramatic.

fields.label: Gap Color
fields.help: Color of the void behind lifted tiles as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range.

fields.label: Shadow
fields.help: Opacity of the drop shadows under lifted tiles (0 to 2).

fields.label: Shading
fields.help: Strength of the per-tile lighting (0 to 2).

fields.label: Refraction
fields.help: How strongly lifted shards refract the content beneath them, like glass (0 to 2).

fields.label: Dispersion
fields.help: Chromatic fringing of the refraction (0 to 1). 0 keeps it color-true.

fields.label: Float speed
fields.help: Speed of the floating tile motion. 0 freezes the tiles.

fields.label: Strength
fields.help: How fully tiles lift inside the lens (0 to 1).

fields.label: Base strength
fields.help: Lift amount across the whole screen, outside the lens (0 to 1).

fields.label: Follow speed
fields.help: How quickly the lens follows the cursor. Higher is snappier.

fields.label: Speed
fields.help: Playback speed of the tape artifacts. 1 is normal speed.

fields.label: Wave
fields.help: Strength of the slow horizontal tape wave (0 to 3).

fields.label: Jitter
fields.help: Strength of the fine per-line horizontal jitter (0 to 3).

fields.label: Crease
fields.help: Strength of the travelling tape crease band (0 to 3).

fields.label: Switching
fields.help: Strength of the head-switching noise at the bottom (0 to 3).

fields.label: Switch height
fields.help: Height of the head-switching band as a fraction of the screen.

fields.label: Bloom
fields.help: Strength of the horizontal glow bleed (0 to 1).

fields.label: Aberration
fields.help: RGB channel misalignment in CSS pixels.

fields.label: AC beat
fields.help: Strength of the slow brightness beat rolling down the frame (0 to 1).

fields.label: Grain
fields.help: Amount of animated static grain (0 to 1).

fields.label: Scanlines
fields.help: Intensity of the CRT scanline overlay (0 to 1).

fields.label: Vignette
fields.help: Darkening toward the frame corners (0 to 1).

fields.label: Barrel
fields.help: CRT tube curvature bending the frame inward (0 to 1). 0 disables.

fields.label: Saturation
fields.help: Color saturation. 1 keeps the content's colors, 0 is grayscale.

fields.label: Exposure
fields.help: Extra brightness multiplier applied at the end.
